flags.why: This loom component supports the heddle cords, rather than holding the weft thread ([dictionary](https://www.thuvienlamdong.org.vn/Files/Books/53119.pdf)).
flags.fix: Gloss: wooden loom component, often crow-shaped, used to attach the heddle cords; example: Cái ác ở khung cửi có hình con quạ. = The wooden heddle support on the loom is shaped like a crow.

flags.why: The entry omits the familiar colloquial meaning of killing or eliminating someone ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/khu-eT5Vq6fpGhgwG.html)).
flags.fix: Add verb [colloquial]: to kill; to eliminate (someone).

flags.why: Thơm can describe a kiss between romantic partners, so 'without romance' is a false restriction.
The affectionate verb means to kiss, not a separate act of sniffing someone's hair ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%C6%A1m)).
flags.fix: Merge into sense 3 and translate the example as: Grandma bent down and kissed her little grandchild's hair.

flags.why: The literary sense is a verb meaning to compose poetry about something, rather than the name of a poem genre ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-v%E1%BB%8Bnh)).
flags.fix: verb [literary] | to compose a poem about a scene or subject; example: Nhà thơ vịnh cảnh mùa xuân. = The poet composes a poem about the spring scenery.

flags.why: Đông describes the guests themselves, whereas số lượng requires a quantity adjective such as lớn.
flags.fix: Số lượng khách hôm nay rất lớn. = The number of guests today is very large.

flags.why: The entry omits the everyday verb used in expressions such as chăng màn, chăng dây and nhện chăng tơ ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%C4%83ng)).
flags.fix: Add verb: to stretch out; to string up (a net, cord or mosquito net); example: Nhện chăng tơ. = The spider spins its web.

flags.why: The concessive construction chăng nữa remains common in contemporary Vietnamese and is misleadingly tagged rare.
